//: Plugins the marketplace sync must never bundle into apps/desktop/resources/plugins. Ids listed here are skipped by scripts/sync-bundled-plugins.mjs and any already-expanded copy is removed.
//cn.star.skill-learning: Retired into core by ADR 0377: the app's own skill review owns the skill library now, so shipping the plugin again would put a second writer on ~/.agents/skills.
//io.github.czp0312.subscription-quota: Retired 2026-11-04: this deployment does not track subscription quota.
//io.github.xinzhihong.group-rooms: Retired 2026-11-04: shared rooms are unused in this deployment.
//io.github.xideadev.pi-wechatbot: Retired 2026-11-04: the WeChat bridge is unused in this deployment.
//local.hindsight.memory: Retired 2026-11-04: this deployment does not bundle the Hindsight memory bridge.
//local.unipi: Retired 2026-11-04: the Muse learning adaptation is unused in this deployment.
//theme-plugins: Retired 2026-11-06: a declarative theme plugin costs a whole host process (~30 MB) on every launch and needs none of it. Built-in color schemes cover appearance; see ADR 0412.
//theme-plugins-extra: Retired 2026-11-06: same host-process cost as //theme-plugins. Theme authoring belongs in the app; skins ship as data, not as plugins.
//native-helper-terminals: Retired 2026-11-06: both terminals launch an unsigned helper binary (fancy-pty-helper.exe / pi-conpty-helper.exe) from the app's own resource directory. On a host with behaviour-based endpoint protection, an unsigned app spawning unknown executables it shipped itself is indistinguishable from a dropper and gets the whole app flagged. local.terminal covers the same feature in pure JavaScript.
//development-harness-only: Retired 2026-11-06: development fixtures. One is an offline-harness manifest, the other an API probe; neither is a user-facing feature.
//duplicate-usage-views: Retired 2026-11-06: io.github.new-beginner.session-usage is the tracked pick and covers the same accounting; shipping three more usage panels only adds host processes.
//duplicate-browser: Retired 2026-11-06: pi.browser is the tracked browser plugin; a second browser plugin doubles the CDP surface for no extra capability.
//market-translator: Retired 2026-11-06: the marketplace feed is not reachable from this deployment, so a catalog translator has nothing to translate.
